Name: Linde plc Ordinary Shares
Description: Linde plc is a leading multinational chemical company and the world's largest industrial gas supplier by market share and revenue. The company caters to a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, petroleum refining, manufacturing, food and beverage, steel production, aerospace, and electronics. Linde specializes in the production and distribution of atmospheric gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, and argon, as well as process gases including hydrogen, helium, and specialty gases. With a strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, Linde plays a crucial role in enhancing operational efficiencies and reducing carbon footprints for its customers worldwide.
